result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there is an untranslated localization key rendered as a section heading, and an inconsistent favorite-button style between the two popular restaurant cards.

issues.description: The second section heading displays the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title such as 'Popular near you'.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for the 'home_feed.popular_title' key and verify the locale bundle is loaded so the resolved label renders.

issues.description: The heart/favorite buttons on the two popular restaurant cards use different styles — the first is a white circle with a dark outline heart, the second is a dark/translucent circle with a white heart — creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background and icon color across all restaurant cards (e.g., always a white circle with a dark outline heart, filled when active).

issues.description: The promo banner's decorative circular shapes are clipped oddly at the right edge and the lighter overlay creates a visible hard seam across the banner.
issues.suggestion: Ensure decorative shapes are clipped by the banner's rounded container with proper overflow handling and soften the overlay so no hard vertical seam appears.
